3 Output Conversion with 3C Helper 3.1 Understanding TLF Formats RapTLR’s run_apdx() function inserts TLFs into your Word document. To work properly, your outputs must be in .DOCX format. As outputs are generally .RTF they need to be converted as .DOCX and for that the tool 3C Helper is used. 3.2 What is 3C Helper? 3C Helper is a companion tool that converts various output formats to .DOCX. The purpose of this tool is to convert your RTF outputs generated by SAS into DOCX and use them to create for each a bookmark and incorporate them into the TLR document. 3.3 How to download 3C Helper You can download 3C Helper on this page and click on Download 3C Helper, version 2.1.5. If needed you can read the user guide in Confluence on this page. 3.4 Converting your RTF outputs into DOCX 3.4.1 Example from the TLR package In the R package we provided dummy rtf outputs that you can use to practice with 3C Helper. They are also accessible here. You can use the function import_RTFs() to copy and create a clone folder of dummy rtf outputs in your working directory. See below. library(RapTLR) import_RTFs() If succeeded in your console you should receive this message: [INFO] rtf_outputs folder has been successfully imported and copied under: ... 3.4.2 How to use 3C Helper: After having imported the .RTF outputs, the next step is to convert them to .DOCX format Open 3C Helper Select Convert in the sidebar Type: RTF -> DOCX Folder/File(s): Folder Input Folder: Provide a folder path of .RTF outputs (like the one created above) Output Folder: Whatever folder where you want your new converted .DOCX outputs Click Convert 3.4.3 Summary video (no sound) The following recording shows in details how to use the import_RTFs() function and 3C Helper to convert RTF outputs into DOCX format. 3.5 Working with SPACE When creating your TLR, the outputs should be saved in SPACE under PREPROD or PROD. When you connect your R Session to the corresponding RE, R automatically creates “libpaths” that you can use to access the different folders and pillar. In the following steps, we are trying to imitate a proper study structure. 3.5.1 Accessing the Report Effort and Connect to R The first step is to get access to the compound called test_compound in SPACE. To have access, you need to summit this SAM request: Select Environment: PROD Request Type: Add Access Compound: test_compound Therapeutic Area: None -> Click on Other TA Other TA: Test_compound access Selecting Existing SPACE User: Find yourself Add attachments: Provide a word document with the sentence: Accessing test_compound Once you have access, go to (Do not forget to assign yourself at every step: ACTIONS -> Assign myself): test_compound r_training_stats dbr_intro_to_r re_raptlr Don’t forget to assign yourself and then click on ACTIONS -> Launch R Studio Enter your JnJ Credentials Start a New Session then click Start Session Click on Addins then click Go to QC Programs PDEV Project (If you don’t see it, go to 8). If R asks you if want to save your workspace, click Don't Save. In case you don’t see Go to QC Programs PDEV Project, you need to install the following R packages: install.packages("ellipsis") install.packages("generics") install.packages("data.table") install.packages("jjutils", repos = c("https://rstudiopm.jnj.com/JNJ/__linux__/centos8/latest", "https://rstudiopm.jnj.com/CRAN/__linux__/centos8/latest")) After R has downloaded all the required packages, you should be able to proceed to step 7. 3.5.2 How to convert outputs in SPACE In SPACE under OUPUTS & ANALYSIS from re_raptlr there are four .RTF dummy outputs available (tsidem03, tefmad01a, tsfae10, lsfae03) for conversion using 3C Helper. 3C Helper uses RaiDrive to access the outputs, and in the following steps, Z: refers to the RaiDrive drive mapping. Open 3C Helper Select Convert in the sidebar Type: RTF -> DOCX Folder/File(s): Folder Input Folder: Select folder rtf in Z:\adr\PREPROD\pharma\test_compound\r_training_stats\dbr_intro_to_r\re_raptlr\output - Be sure to use your JnJ Credential Output Folder: Create folder docx and select in Z:\adr\PDEV\astos1\pharma\test_compound\r_training_stats\dbr_intro_to_r\re_raptlr\qc\docx - Be sure to use your JnJ Credential Click Convert The new .DOCX outputs should be available your R session as well. 3.5.3 Summary video (no sound) The following recording shows in details how to convert .RTF to .DOCX outputs in SPACE using 3C Helper. 3.5.4 Notes Be aware that the destination of the outputs should always be under OUTPUTS & ANALYIS but they could be in PREPROP or PROD Do not forget to Assign myself at every level Be careful to use the correct path between SPACE and RaiDrive It’s possible that the Reporting Effort has not been set up for R before, you will get an error message saying: Error: Did you setup your Programs PDEV?. Contact the study lead programmer. If you need more guidance about R in SPACE, you can access the Confluence page
